issuerName: KKR Real Estate Finance Trust Inc.

segments.name: Real estate finance
segments.description: Originates and acquires transitional senior loans and related debt investments secured by commercial real estate owned by experienced sponsors.
segments.evidence: As a result, KREF conducts its business as a single operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest on senior and mezzanine loans and preferred returns on preferred equity investments.
revenueModel.evidence: The loans may vary in duration, bear interest at a fixed or floating rate and amortize, and typically require a balloon payment of principal at maturity, but are typically anticipated to be floating rate and shorter-term duration.
